C1829.title: Qufu, Shandong: Login-State Account Theft Ring Broken, Account Sellers Hoarded by Virtual-Asset Tier, 30 Million Yuan Involved
C1829.summary: In 2024, police in Qufu, Jining, Shandong dismantled a criminal chain that used trojan programs to steal game accounts and virtual equipment, arresting 17 people with over 30 million yuan involved. The gang had clear division of labor: Yang stole over 4 million 'login-state' data records for 1.4 million+ yuan, Xu compiled 11 trojan programs, and as a 'big account seller' Zhang filtered and classified accounts by level, type, and virtual-asset value before selling them to downstream sellers; Chen bought black-market accounts cheaply and resold them for 200,000 yuan profit. The case reveals game accounts being used as virtual-asset stores and fencing transit nodes; police seized over 37 million pieces of citizen personal data.
